summary: Project with Stripe Premium Subscription system and ad revenue monetization features.
architectural_notes: Stripe Premium Subscription system integrated for user payments

existing_features.title: Fix the broken Stripe premium subscription flow end-to-end. The `createCheckoutSession` backend call must correctly generate a Stripe checkout URL. The `useCreateCheckoutSession` hook must properly redirect the user to the Stripe-hosted payment page. After payment, `PaymentSuccess.tsx` must verify the session and call `setSubscriptionStatus` to upgrade the user to premium. After payment failure/cancellation, `PaymentFailure.tsx` must allow the user to retry. The `useGetUserSubscriptionStatus` hook must reflect the correct tier ('free' or 'premium') from the backend at all times.

Add an ad revenue dashboard UI. Create a new 'Ad Revenue' section visible in the user's Profile page and/or Settings page for authenticated users. It must display: total ad earnings (fetched via `getAdRevenueForCaller()`), a per-video breakdown showing each video's title, total impressions, and estimated revenue. Simulate an ad impression by calling `recordAdImpression` when a video has been watched for at least 10 seconds on the VideoPlayer page.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add ad revenue method for monetization

Add an ad revenue system to the backend. Implement a data model to track ad impressions and revenue per video and per creator. Add backend endpoints: `recordAdImpression(videoId)` to log an ad view and accrue simulated revenue to the video uploader, `getAdRevenueForCaller()` to return the total ad revenue earned by the authenticated caller, and `getAdRevenueForVideo(videoId)` to return revenue for a specific video. Revenue should be calculated at a fixed simulated CPM rate (e.g., $2.00 per 1000 impressions).
